## About
Remodeling a house you live in means a lot of details, options and decisions. You want good quality, fair cost and a schedule that holds, especially while you're living there during construction. Keeping it simple is our commitment to you: be there when you need us, explain things, solve problems, mind the details, be on time and be honest.
Simple Builders is run by owner Gilad Mimran, who most customers know as Gil. Homeowners have named Jesus, Haim, David and Marcos in their reviews too. We serve communities in Concord and Los Angeles, and we're licensed, insured and bonded.
We're rated 4.8 from 22 Google reviews.

## Services
- Kitchen Remodeling: Modern, classic, contemporary or minimalistic. We offer design options and help with selecting and sourcing finish materials, from custom built cabinets to a specific backsplash tile.
- Bathroom Remodeling: We focus on safety, design and cost. Proper waterproofing comes first, and we show you the materials we'll use and explain their quality. Work can range from basic to completely custom.
- Decks & Balconies: We help you choose the right deck material and a layout that fits your yard and the elements, and check it carefully so it doesn't put the house framing or footing at risk.
- Windows & Doors: Retrofit, new construction and sliding doors in vinyl, aluminum or fiberglass. We evaluate first to find the right door or window, then install it with a guaranty on every one.
- Garage Conversion: From figuring out the layout to the last touch ups: framing, plumbing, electrical, foundation, insulation, windows, drywall, paint, kitchen, bathroom and flooring. You get regular progress updates and a well kept job site.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Send us your contact information and a short message about your project, and we'll call to schedule an appointment.

Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. We're licensed, insured and bonded.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve communities in Concord and Los Angeles, with an East Bay branch on San Carlos Ave in Concord.

Q: How does a project work?
A: We start with an estimate and talk through your vision. Then we help you pick materials and colors, our crew completes the project on schedule, and you get to enjoy the result.
